stations.title: Rosamund
stations.say: Where do the microchip numbers go?

stations.title: The database
stations.text: Four tables, and none for chips or vets.

captions: Rosamund wants the microchip numbers off their cards and into the database.
The database has no table for them, so Bear's chip number stays on a card at the desk.
You make five tables, each with rules that refuse a bad row, in five tasks.
Now Bear's chip is on record, and a number used twice is refused.
Same database, with new tables that keep their own rules.
